name: doudian-platform-hub
description: 基于 CDP 的多平台电商工作台，首期支持抖店并兼容可导入的闲鱼 Hook 包

scripts.build:hooks: pnpm --dir packages/doudian-hook build && pnpm --dir packages/kuaishou-hook build && pnpm --dir packages/douyin-hook build
scripts.build:foundation: pnpm --dir packages/hook-sdk build && pnpm --dir packages/hook-host build && pnpm --dir packages/fake-hook build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir packages/hook-sdk typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/hook-host typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/fake-hook typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/doudian-hook typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/kuaishou-hook typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/douyin-hook typecheck && vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json
scripts.test:unit: pnpm build:foundation && pnpm --dir packages/douyin-hook build && node --test tests/hook-sdk.test.mjs tests/douyin-hook-unit.test.mjs
scripts.test:contract: pnpm build:foundation && pnpm --dir packages/douyin-hook build && node --test tests/hook-phase0.test.mjs tests/douyin-hook-contract.test.mjs
scripts.verify:douyin: pnpm build:foundation && pnpm --dir packages/douyin-hook build && electron scripts/verify-douyin.mjs
scripts.verify:douyin:multi: pnpm build:foundation && pnpm --dir packages/douyin-hook build && electron scripts/verify-douyin-multi.mjs
